adx-dmi.description: +DI/-DI crossovers confirmed by ADX above a threshold; exits when ADX fades.

bold-play.description: Control: bets as much as 1:200 allows (or just enough to reach $20,000) on ±0.25% moves until the account doubles or is ruined.

bollinger-fade.description: Fades Bollinger band extremes back to the mean while ADX says the market is ranging.

buy-hold.description: Benchmark: long from the first bar at 1:1 and never sells; crypto and shares hold fee-free, the rest pay CFD funding.

constant-leverage.description: Control: holds half the account leverage as a constant multiple of equity (1×, 2.5×, 10×), rebalanced like a leveraged ETF.

crypto-sunday-asia.description: Long BTC and ETH from Sunday 19:00 to Monday 19:00 New York, as Asia opens the week; 1:1, fee-free.

donchian-breakout.description: Turtle-style breakout of the previous N-bar high/low, exit on the shorter opposite channel.

donchian-ensemble.description: Averages five breakout systems (10 to 200 days) into one long-only position, volatility-scaled, on BTC and ETH at 1:1.

ema-cross.description: Fast/slow EMA crossover with an ATR stop; always in the market after the first signal.

gold-session.description: Long gold from the London afternoon fix (15:00) to the next morning fix (10:30); the "both" variant is short in between.

hma-slope.description: Goes with the slope of a Hull moving average; reverses when the slope turns.

ibs-dip.description: Buys US indices when the cash session closes near its low (IBS < 0.2) above the 200-day average; out on the next strong close.

inside-bar.description: Trades the breakout of a mother bar after an inside-bar consolidation.

keltner-trend.description: Enters on closes outside the Keltner channel and exits back at the middle line.

leverage-ladder.description: Control: one signal on every leverage tier with 10% of equity as margin, to show what leverage does on its own.

london-breakout.description: Trades the first break of the Asian-session range during the London morning.

lrs-sma200.description: Long the index at 1×, 2× or 3× equity while it closes above its 200-day average, in cash below.

macd-trend.description: MACD signal-line crossovers taken only in the direction of a long EMA trend.

martingale-monkey.description: Control: random entries, 1 ATR stop and target, risk doubling after each loss (0.5% up to 64%) at 1:200, to show how martingales end.

mtf-pullback.description: Buys 1h pullbacks inside a 4h uptrend (and sells rallies in a 4h downtrend).

night-risk-twin.description: Frozen night signals and deadline, with 0.5% planned capital loss and about 1.8× initial exposure at tier 1:3. Separate normal-gate research; no special demo admission.

noise-area-momentum.description: Rides US index moves that leave their usual intraday range (14-day noise band by time of day); VWAP/band trailing stop, flat by 16:00 New York.

orb-ny.description: Trades the first breakout of the New York opening range on US indices; one trade a day, flat by the close.

overnight-drift.description: Holds US indices from the cash close to the next cash open to capture the overnight premium.

quote-breakout.description: Paired 15m range-breakout study: immediate entry versus a two-minute tick gate for spread and adverse price movement. Identical 0.5% planned risk; US indices only.

random-baseline.description: Control: random long/short entries with a 2 ATR stop and target. Measures how good luck looks.

rsi2-reversion.description: Buys RSI(2) extremes in the direction of the 200-bar trend and exits on the snap-back.

shannon-demon.description: Holds 50% of equity in a volatile asset and 50% cash at 1:1; rebalances to 50% when the mix leaves 45-55%.

skew-monkey.description: Control: random entries with a 0.5 ATR target and a 3 ATR stop (wins ~85% of trades, no edge), to show what negative skew looks like.

squeeze-breakout.description: Waits for Bollinger bands to squeeze inside Keltner, then trades the breakout with a trailing stop.

stoch-range.description: Stochastic %K/%D crosses at the extremes, taken only in low-ADX (ranging) conditions.

supertrend.description: Rides SuperTrend flips and trails the stop on the SuperTrend line.

swing-reversal.description: Enters after price moves a fixed percentage off its recent swing low/high (v1 trend-follower).

timesfm-band.description: Fades closes that land outside the previous bar's TimesFM 10-90% band when the new forecast expects a retrace.

timesfm-drift.description: Follows the TimesFM 3 median forecast when its expected move is large relative to the forecast band.

timesfm-swing.description: Trades a day-ahead TimesFM forecast on 4h bars only when its inner (30-70%) band is entirely above or below the price.

timesfm-trend.description: Takes EMA-trend trades only when the TimesFM forecast agrees; exits on disagreement.

timesfm-vol-breakout.description: Channel breakouts taken only when TimesFM forecasts unusually wide price ranges (expected volatility expansion).

tsmom-12m.description: Long or short each market by the sign of its 12-month return, sized to 15% annual volatility (up to 3×), rebalanced monthly.

tsmom.description: Holds long when the trailing return is positive and short when negative (trend premium).

turn-of-month.description: Holds US indices and the largest Nasdaq shares from two days before the month ends to the third trading day of the next; flat otherwise.

visar-night-trading.description: US500: follow a directional NY session after a 03:27 pullback from the 22:00 reference. Skip neutral, volatile and FOMC/BOJ decision days; target 25–50 entries/year. Exit 08:27 or at a 50% capital-loss stop. Albania time, 1:200.

vol-managed-hold.description: Holds the 8 largest Nasdaq shares, BTC and ETH at 1:1, scaled down when the last month is more volatile than the last year.

vol-target.description: Long US indices sized to a 15% annual volatility from the last month of returns (0-2× equity), rebalanced monthly.

volatility-breakout.description: Enters when price moves k × yesterday's range away from today's open; flat by the daily close.

zscore-fade.description: Fades price when it stretches more than ~2 standard deviations from its rolling mean.

visar-night-lab.description: Visar night cohort: previous NY path, overnight pullback, variant-specific thresholds, leverage and per-trade loss limit; same 03:27/08:27 Albania clock.

visar-night-us100.description: Visar US100 overnight cohort: previous NY path, overnight pullback, variant-specific thresholds and loss limit; same 03:27/08:27 Albania clock.

visar-night-v2-us500.description: US500 night: full/central day, overnight bid gap, then capital-profit target/loss budget or 08:27 Tirana.

visar-night-v2-us100.description: US100 night: full/central day, overnight bid gap, then capital-profit target/loss budget or 08:27 Tirana.

visar-night-v2-control-us500.description: US500 direction control: the frequent-core night's eligible days, always long or a random side, same exits.

visar-night-v2-control-us100.description: US100 direction control: the frequent-core night's eligible days, always long or a random side, same exits.
